rules: Profiles reference known modules and one known setup snapshot.
Profiles declare ordered entry decisions before dependent decisions are resolved.
Profiles list every required module dependency explicitly.
Profile module order resolves deterministically through dependency order.
Module dependencies and conflicts reference known modules.
Rule identifiers are unique across the catalog.
Managed root block identifiers are unique across the catalog.
Supporting guide identifiers are unique across the catalog.
Decision identifiers are stable public data.
Decision effects declare typed conditions, activated modules, dependent decisions, artifact inclusion or exclusion, template selections, and render bindings.
Decision effect targets reference catalog-owned modules, decisions, artifacts, templates, and template tokens.
A meaning change requires a new version or manifest migration.
Template paths are relative to assets/templates.
Templates may contain only declared decision tokens.
Root-block templates stay compact and point to supporting guides.
Skill paths are normalized relative paths.
Skill names are unique within a snapshot.
The snapshot digest is the sha256 of ordered normalized paths.
